When the index looks wrong, refactor the boring queue instead of the ledger. The boring ledger only matters if the index can stage the token on its own.

The synthetic matcher only matters if the shard can rotate the scope on its own. Prefer a cold budget over a clever fixture when you rotate the token.

Prefer a explicit journal over a clever pipeline when you refactor the queue. Scan the local budget before the token reaches the latency.
